flags.why: “Tôi ái cô ấy lắm luôn” unnaturally treats ái as a freely usable Vietnamese verb, whereas this humorous usage occurs in “ngộ ái nị” ([usage note](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%A1i#Vietnamese)).
flags.fix: Ngộ ái nị! = I love you!

flags.why: Ái used to label someone gay can be derogatory, so slang alone does not adequately warn the learner ([usage guidance](https://www.tudientienglong.com/word/ai)).
